scope: Ontario MTO handbook rules about overtaking another vehicle and being overtaken, including passing stopped vehicles, selecting a passing lane, and responding to road users or conditions that restrict passing.

vocabulary.definition: The person operating the vehicle to which the rule applies.
A portion of the roadway that connects opposite sidewalks into a continuous path or is designated for pedestrian crossing by signs, lines or other markings.
A designated pedestrian crossing where there are no traffic lights, identified by specific signs and pavement markings and, where provided, overhead yellow lights.
A high-speed, multi-lane road with opposing traffic on separated roadways and ramps for entry and exit.
A marked centre lane used by left-turning vehicles from both directions to wait for a chance to turn.
A physical barrier, such as a raised, lowered, earth or paved strip, constructed to separate traffic travelling in opposite directions and not crossable by vehicles.
A chrome-yellow bus displaying the words “School Bus.”
A designated stopping area for municipal buses, either in a roadside indentation or between designated parking areas.
An orange triangle with a red border identifying a vehicle travelling at 40 km/h or less.
A double-trailer commercial vehicle, up to 40 metres long, identified by a rear placard.
A condition in which blowing snow completely blocks the driver's view of the road.

rules.title: Keep right except to turn left or pass
rules.when: driving along a road
rules.action: keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road
rules.unless: preparing to turn left OR passing another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving along a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road, UNLESS preparing to turn left OR passing another vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook emphasizes keeping right when travelling more slowly than other traffic; a posted slower-traffic-keep-right sign is regulatory.

rules.title: Clear the truck passing lane
rules.when: on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in the same direction AND large trucks are barred from the far left lane AND a truck wants to pass from behind in the lane immediately to the right of the far left lane occupied by the DRIVER
rules.action: move into the lane to the right as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in the same direction AND large trucks are barred from the far left lane AND a truck wants to pass from behind in the lane immediately to the right of the far left lane occupied by the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST move into the lane to the right as soon as possible.

vague_terms.explanation: no time or gap is specified

rules.note: The handbook says this truck restriction applies on many, not all, such roads.

rules.title: Keep right in a signed climbing or passing section
rules.when: travelling in a signed two-lane section with a climbing or passing lane
rules.action: keep in the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in a signed two-lane section with a climbing or passing lane, the DRIVER MUST keep in the right lane, UNLESS passing another vehicle.
rules.note: The sign makes explicit the keep-right rule described in the passing-lane text.

rules.title: Merge as the climbing or passing lane ends
rules.when: travelling in the right-hand lane of a climbing or passing section AND a sign warns that the right-hand lane is ending
rules.action: merge safely into the lane to the left
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in the right-hand lane of a climbing or passing section AND a sign warns that the right-hand lane is ending, the DRIVER MUST merge safely into the lane to the left.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum merge gap is specified

rules.note: The passing-lane text describes the merge; the right-lane-ends sign states it as a direction.

rules.title: Use freeway left lanes for passing
rules.when: driving on a multi-lane FREEWAY
rules.action: keep right when possible, use the left lanes for passing, and leave the far left lane after passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multi-lane FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST keep right when possible, use the left lanes for passing, and leave the far left lane after passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria for keeping right are specified

rules.note: The general freeway passage says traffic should keep right; the more specific passage directs drivers not to stay in the far left lane.

rules.title: Dim headlights for nearby traffic
rules.when: using high beams AND an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres OR using high beams AND following another vehicle less than 60 metres away
rules.action: switch to low beams on any road, including a divided road
rules.unless: passing the vehicle ahead AND no oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres
rules.statement: WHEN using high beams AND an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres OR using high beams AND following another vehicle less than 60 metres away, the DRIVER MUST switch to low beams on any road, including a divided road, UNLESS passing the vehicle ahead AND no oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to lower the headlight beam.
rules.note: The passing exception applies only to the vehicle being followed; it does not remove the duty to dim for oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Use hand signals if vehicle signals fail
rules.when: signalling a lane change to pass or return after passing AND the vehicle turn signals are not working
rules.action: signal with the left arm straight out for a move left or with the left arm extended and bent upward at a right angle for a move right
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a lane change to pass or return after passing AND the vehicle turn signals are not working, the DRIVER MUST signal with the left arm straight out for a move left or with the left arm extended and bent upward at a right angle for a move right.
rules.note: The arm positions are shown in the diagram.

rules.title: Pass only when it is safe
rules.when: considering overtaking another vehicle
rules.action: begin the pass
rules.unless: there is enough space and time AND the DRIVER is sure the pass can be completed without danger to anyone
rules.statement: WHEN considering overtaking another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT begin the pass, UNLESS there is enough space and time AND the DRIVER is sure the pass can be completed without danger to anyone.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum space or time is given
the driver must judge the risks of the manoeuvre

rules.title: Check and signal before moving out
rules.when: preparing to change lanes to overtake another vehicle
rules.action: check ahead and behind and use the mirrors to find a safe gap, shoulder-check toward the intended lane for bicycles and other vehicles, signal the intended direction well before moving, and recheck that the way is clear, including for fast traffic from behind or traffic moving in from two lanes over
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to change lanes to overtake another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST check ahead and behind and use the mirrors to find a safe gap, shoulder-check toward the intended lane for bicycles and other vehicles, signal the intended direction well before moving, and recheck that the way is clear, including for fast traffic from behind or traffic moving in from two lanes over.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap is given
no signal lead time is specified
no minimum clearance is specified
no approach-speed threshold is given

rules.note: The ordinary passing procedure describes a pass to the left; on a permitted pass to the right the signal must indicate the actual direction.

rules.title: Change lanes gradually and yield
rules.when: changing lanes to pass another vehicle OR changing lanes to return after a pass
rules.action: yield to traffic in the destination lane and steer gradually into it while maintaining speed or gently increasing it without exceeding the speed limit, without cutting in front of another vehicle or bicycle
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to pass another vehicle OR changing lanes to return after a pass, the DRIVER MUST yield to traffic in the destination lane and steer gradually into it while maintaining speed or gently increasing it without exceeding the speed limit, without cutting in front of another vehicle or bicycle.

vague_terms.explanation: no steering rate is specified
no acceleration rate is specified
no minimum clearance is specified

rules.note: Signalling does not give the lane-changing driver the right-of-way; the speed limit still applies.

rules.title: Cancel the signal after changing lanes
rules.when: a lane change made to pass or return after passing is complete
rules.action: make sure the turn signal is off
rules.statement: WHEN a lane change made to pass or return after passing is complete, the DRIVER MUST make sure the turn signal is off.
rules.note: Diagram 2-45 shows this as the final step; the road-test text also states it explicitly.

rules.title: Look for hazards hidden by the vehicle ahead
rules.when: preparing to overtake a vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden ahead of it, vehicles that may turn left in front of the DRIVER, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to overtake a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden ahead of it, vehicles that may turn left in front of the DRIVER, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Signal and leave clearance before returning
rules.when: returning to the original lane after overtaking a vehicle
rules.action: signal before changing lanes and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rear-view mirror before moving back without cutting it off
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after overtaking a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST signal before changing lanes and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rear-view mirror before moving back without cutting it off.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum physical clearance is given

rules.note: The night-passing instructions repeat the same visual check.

rules.title: Abandon the pass if the other vehicle speeds up
rules.when: the vehicle being overtaken speeds up
rules.action: return to the original lane instead of racing the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being overtaken speeds up, the DRIVER MUST return to the original lane instead of racing the other vehicle.

rules.title: Watch for doors when passing parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch for doors opening suddenly or already open for loading or unloading
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the DRIVER MUST watch for doors opening suddenly or already open for loading or unloading.

rules.title: Use low beams on the approach to a night pass
rules.when: approaching a vehicle from behind at night to pass it
rules.action: switch to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle from behind at night to pass it, the DRIVER MUST switch to low beams.
rules.note: The night-passing sequence gives no separate distance for the approach; the general rule requires low beams when following less than 60 metres behind.

rules.title: Switch to high beams when alongside at night
rules.when: moving alongside a vehicle being passed at night
rules.action: switch on high beams to see farther ahead
rules.unless: an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres
rules.statement: WHEN moving alongside a vehicle being passed at night, the DRIVER MUST switch on high beams to see farther ahead, UNLESS an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres.
rules.note: The exception comes from the general requirement to dim high beams for nearby oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: pass the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: This applies to crosswalks generally, including unmarked crosswalks, not only to pedestrian crossovers.

rules.title: Do not pass within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Both passages state a prohibition; neither makes it conditional on pedestrians being present.

rules.title: Do not pass using a shared left-turn lane
rules.when: a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is present
rules.action: use that lane to pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is present, the DRIVER MUST NOT use that lane to pass another vehicle.
rules.note: The regulatory sign reserves the lane for two-way left turns only.

rules.title: Do not change lanes to pass in or near an intersection
rules.when: in or near an intersection
rules.action: change lanes to pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN in or near an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT change lanes to pass another vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance is specified

rules.note: The handbook gives a direct instruction not to change lanes in or near an intersection, alongside softer advice against unnecessary lane changes generally.

rules.title: Do not pass left of centre near a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass another vehicle by driving left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass another vehicle by driving left of the centreline.
rules.note: The handbook says “30 metres from” and does not distinguish the approach side from the departure side.

rules.title: Do not pass with an obstructed view at a hill or curve
rules.when: approaching a hillcrest with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic and not enough clear distance ahead to pass safely OR on a curve with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic and not enough clear distance ahead to pass safely
rules.action: attempt to pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a hillcrest with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic and not enough clear distance ahead to pass safely OR on a curve with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic and not enough clear distance ahead to pass safely, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass another vehicle.

vague_terms.term: not enough clear distance ahead to pass safely
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum sight distance is specified

rules.title: Do not change lanes to overtake in a construction zone
rules.when: driving through a construction zone
rules.action: change lanes to overtake another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving through a construction zone, the DRIVER MUST NOT change lanes to overtake another vehicle.
rules.note: This applies the handbook's no-lane-change instruction to overtaking; it is not an instruction to ignore a lane closure or traffic direction.

rules.title: Do not pass other vehicles in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: pass another vehicle or speed up to overtake a slower vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass another vehicle or speed up to overtake a slower vehicle.
rules.note: The initial tip says to avoid passing; the later reminder directly says not to pass.

rules.title: Avoid passing in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.when: driving in blowing snow OR driving in a WHITEOUT
rules.action: pass other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow OR driving in a WHITEOUT, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass other vehicles.
rules.note: A separate instruction specifically says not to attempt to pass a slow-moving vehicle in these conditions.

rules.title: Do not attempt to pass a slow vehicle in blowing snow
rules.when: following a slow-moving vehicle in blowing snow OR following a slow-moving vehicle in a WHITEOUT
rules.action: attempt to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN following a slow-moving vehicle in blowing snow OR following a slow-moving vehicle in a WHITEOUT, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass that vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: the whiteout guidance gives no speed threshold

rules.note: The wording is stronger for this situation than the general advice to avoid passing in blowing snow.

rules.title: Obey a no-passing sign
rules.when: travelling on a road subject to a no-passing sign
rules.action: pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN travelling on a road subject to a no-passing sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.note: The sign shows two vehicles inside a slashed red circle.

rules.title: Do not pass between a crossover sign and the crossing
rules.when: between a sign reading “No passing here to crossing” and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it identifies
rules.action: pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN between a sign reading “No passing here to crossing” and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it identifies, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.note: The words establishing the signed no-passing segment appear in the figure; the caption identifies the pedestrian crossover but does not state that segment.

rules.title: Do not pass a pilot or pace vehicle displaying a flashing restriction
rules.when: a pilot or pace vehicle displays the no-passing sign marked “When flashing” AND the sign's warning is flashing
rules.action: pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a pilot or pace vehicle displays the no-passing sign marked “When flashing” AND the sign's warning is flashing, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass that vehicle.
rules.note: The caption directs drivers not to pass; the flashing condition appears on the sign face.

rules.title: Slow or stop behind a vehicle blocking the intersection lane
rules.actor: DRIVER taking the Level Two road test
rules.when: going through an intersection AND the driver's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or edging into the intersection from the right
rules.action: slow down or stop rather than pull out to pass the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN going through an intersection AND the driver's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or edging into the intersection from the right, the DRIVER taking the Level Two road test MUST slow down or stop rather than pull out to pass the vehicle.
rules.note: This specific blocked-lane instruction appears in the road-test guide.

rules.title: Do not pass beside a solid line on the left
rules.when: the pavement line immediately to the left of the driver's lane is solid
rules.action: pass across that line
rules.statement: WHEN the pavement line immediately to the left of the driver's lane is solid, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass across that line.
rules.note: The handbook calls passing unsafe and says the illustrated driver should not pass; it does not state a general legal prohibition here.

rules.title: Pass beside a broken line only with clear space
rules.when: the pavement line immediately to the left of the driver's lane is broken AND the way is clear AND there is enough broken line ahead to complete the pass safely
rules.action: pass across that line
rules.statement: WHEN the pavement line immediately to the left of the driver's lane is broken AND the way is clear AND there is enough broken line ahead to complete the pass safely, the DRIVER MAY pass across that line.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap is given

vague_terms.term: enough broken line ahead to complete the pass safely
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum length is given

rules.note: The diagram shows that with paired lines the marking nearest the driver's lane governs this guidance.

rules.title: Use a paved right shoulder only to pass a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle to be overtaken is turning left
rules.action: use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle to be overtaken is turning left, the DRIVER MAY ONLY use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle.
rules.note: MAY ONLY restricts the use of the shoulder; it does not require passing the left-turning vehicle on the shoulder.

rules.title: Do not pass on the left shoulder
rules.when: considering passing another vehicle using the left shoulder
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder whether it is paved or unpaved
rules.statement: WHEN considering passing another vehicle using the left shoulder, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder whether it is paved or unpaved.

rules.title: Situations permitting a pass on the right
rules.when: on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER MAY pass on the right.
rules.note: The permissions do not override the separate restriction on using a shoulder or the conditions for passing safely.

rules.title: Wait rather than dart right around slower traffic
rules.when: following a slower vehicle in the leftmost lane
rules.action: wait for the vehicle to move right instead of suddenly changing lanes to pass it on the right
rules.statement: WHEN following a slower vehicle in the leftmost lane, the DRIVER MUST wait for the vehicle to move right instead of suddenly changing lanes to pass it on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no timing or steering-rate threshold is given

rules.note: The slower vehicle may move right at the same time to let the driver pass.

rules.title: Use the lane to discourage an unsafe pass
rules.actor: DRIVER of a bicycle or moped
rules.when: travelling slower than surrounding traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely
rules.action: use any part of the lane as necessary to discourage passing
rules.statement: WHEN travelling slower than surrounding traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely, the DRIVER of a bicycle or moped MAY use any part of the lane as necessary to discourage passing.

vague_terms.term: too narrow to be shared safely
vague_terms.explanation: no lane width is specified
the rider must judge the needed lane position

rules.note: The handbook states this as a safety exception to the usual right-side riding position.

rules.title: Leave at least one metre when passing a cyclist
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: maintain at least 1 metre between the motor vehicle and the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST maintain at least 1 metre between the motor vehicle and the CYCLIST, UNLESS maintaining 1 metre is not practical.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: the handbook gives no criteria for this exception

rules.note: The exception does not authorize a pass that would endanger the cyclist.

rules.title: Do not sound the horn unnecessarily when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn
rules.unless: the DRIVER judges that using the horn is necessary
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT sound the horn, UNLESS the DRIVER judges that using the horn is necessary.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific conditions for horn use are given

rules.note: A horn may startle the cyclist and cause loss of control.

rules.title: Use a short, light horn tap at a distance
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST AND horn use is necessary
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance from the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST AND horn use is necessary, the DRIVER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance from the CYCLIST.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific conditions for horn use are given
no duration or sound level is specified
no distance is specified

rules.title: Leave extra room before returning in front of a large vehicle
rules.when: overtaking a large commercial vehicle
rules.action: allow extra room before moving back in front of it and do not cut in closely
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a large commercial vehicle, the DRIVER MUST allow extra room before moving back in front of it and do not cut in closely.

vague_terms.explanation: no additional clearance is specified
no minimum return gap is specified

rules.note: The stopping distances in the diagram are illustrative, not required gaps for returning after a pass.

rules.title: Do not move up inside a large vehicle's right turn
rules.when: a large vehicle ahead swings left to make a right turn AND space opens to its right
rules.action: move up into the space on its right before the large vehicle has completely cleared the lane
rules.statement: WHEN a large vehicle ahead swings left to make a right turn AND space opens to its right, the DRIVER MUST NOT move up into the space on its right before the large vehicle has completely cleared the lane.
rules.note: The trailer can move back into the open space as it follows the tractor around the corner.

rules.title: Do not move up inside a large vehicle's left turn
rules.when: a large vehicle ahead is turning left AND an adjacent left-turn lane is available on its left
rules.action: move up into the lane to its left before the large vehicle has cleared the turn
rules.statement: WHEN a large vehicle ahead is turning left AND an adjacent left-turn lane is available on its left, the DRIVER MUST NOT move up into the lane to its left before the large vehicle has cleared the turn.
rules.note: The handbook gives an expressway off-ramp with two left-turn lanes as an example.

rules.title: Slow down behind signed slow-moving vehicles
rules.when: approaching a vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind
rules.action: watch for the slow-moving vehicle and reduce speed as necessary
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind, the DRIVER MUST watch for the slow-moving vehicle and reduce speed as necessary.

vague_terms.explanation: no target approach speed is specified

rules.title: Wait behind farm machinery until safe to pass
rules.when: approaching farm machinery displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind
rules.action: slow down, use caution, stay well back, and wait until it is safe to pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching farm machinery displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind, the DRIVER MUST slow down, use caution, stay well back, and wait until it is safe to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no particular precaution is specified beyond the listed actions
no following distance is specified
no minimum passing gap or sight distance is specified

rules.note: Farm machinery may be oversized or turn directly into fields.

rules.title: Pass horse-drawn vehicles slowly and with maximum clearance
rules.when: approaching a horse-drawn vehicle from behind
rules.action: slow down, use extra caution, maintain a safe following distance, and pass only when safe while giving as much clearance as possible
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a horse-drawn vehicle from behind, the DRIVER MUST slow down, use extra caution, maintain a safe following distance, and pass only when safe while giving as much clearance as possible.

vague_terms.explanation: no additional manoeuvre is prescribed
no horse-specific following gap is given
no minimum passing gap is given
no minimum lateral distance is specified

rules.note: Passing too closely can startle the horse and cause it to change direction suddenly.

rules.title: Wait before passing a smaller vehicle after a left turn
rules.when: making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: stay behind it rather than pull alongside to turn at the same time, turn when the way is clear, and wait for it to move right before passing
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST stay behind it rather than pull alongside to turn at the same time, turn when the way is clear, and wait for it to move right before passing.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap is specified

rules.note: Moving right does not invite a pass within the same lane.

rules.title: Do not pass a moving snowplow
rules.when: a snowplow is moving
rules.action: overtake the snowplow, including by passing between staggered moving snowplows
rules.statement: WHEN a snowplow is moving, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake the snowplow, including by passing between staggered moving snowplows.
rules.note: The handbook prohibits passing a moving snowplow under any conditions and separately warns about attempting to pass between plows clearing lanes together; flashing blue lights identify snow-removal vehicles.

rules.title: Change lanes to pass a motorcycle, bicycle or moped
rules.when: overtaking a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: change lanes to pass instead of passing in the same lane, even if the other vehicle moves to one side of its lane
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST change lanes to pass instead of passing in the same lane, even if the other vehicle moves to one side of its lane.
rules.note: The cyclist-specific passage advises changing lanes whenever possible; the passing chapter gives the stronger direction to change lanes and illustrates it for a bicycle.

rules.title: Slow down and pass roadside workers and hazards cautiously
rules.when: passing roadside workers, roadside-assistance vehicles or disabled vehicles posing a hazard on or near the road
rules.action: slow down and pass with caution, moving over one lane if safe to increase clearance
rules.statement: WHEN passing roadside workers, roadside-assistance vehicles or disabled vehicles posing a hazard on or near the road, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass with caution, moving over one lane if safe to increase clearance.

vague_terms.explanation: no target speed or clearance is specified
no minimum lane-change gap is specified

rules.note: Separate requirements apply to stopped emergency vehicles and tow trucks displaying the specified lights.

rules.title: Slow for a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck displaying warning lights
rules.when: approaching from the same direction of travel a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights OR approaching from the same direction of travel a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights
rules.action: assess surrounding traffic speed and roadway conditions, brake early and gradually, and proceed at reduced speed with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from the same direction of travel a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights OR approaching from the same direction of travel a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, the DRIVER MUST assess surrounding traffic speed and roadway conditions, brake early and gradually, and proceed at reduced speed with caution.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points listed for failing to slow and carefully pass a stopped emergency vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no braking point or deceleration rate is specified
no target speed is specified
no fixed clearance or additional measure is specified

rules.note: The text requires slowing and assessing conditions, and directs early, gradual braking; it does not require a stop merely because the roadside vehicle is stopped.

rules.title: Use the brakes to show deceleration when driving a manual
rules.when: slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights OR slowing to pass a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights
rules.action: use the brakes rather than downshifting to show the reduction in speed with the brake lights
rules.statement: WHEN slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights OR slowing to pass a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, the DRIVER of a manual-transmission vehicle SHOULD use the brakes rather than downshifting to show the reduction in speed with the brake lights.

rules.title: Move over for a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: approaching a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights on a roadway with at least two lanes in the driver's direction OR approaching a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on a roadway with at least two lanes in the driver's direction
rules.action: check surrounding traffic and roadway conditions, signal, recheck mirrors and blind spots, move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance, and continue slowing gradually as safe
rules.unless: a lane change cannot be made safely
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red and blue lights on a roadway with at least two lanes in the driver's direction OR approaching a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on a roadway with at least two lanes in the driver's direction, the DRIVER MUST check surrounding traffic and roadway conditions, signal, recheck mirrors and blind spots, move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance, and continue slowing gradually as safe, UNLESS a lane change cannot be made safely.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points listed for failing to move over where possible for a stopped emergency vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time is specified
no deceleration rate is specified
no braking threshold is specified
no minimum lane-change gap is specified

rules.note: The exception is to moving over, not to the separate duty to reduce speed and proceed with caution.

rules.title: Allow for the length and speed of a double-trailer vehicle
rules.when: preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway
rules.action: recognize its rear placard and allow for its extended length and limited speed when judging the pass
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway, the DRIVER MUST recognize its rear placard and allow for its extended length and limited speed when judging the pass.

vague_terms.explanation: the actual length and speed of the marked vehicle vary

rules.note: The placard shows a double trailer, which can be up to 40 metres long; that is not a prescribed passing gap.

rules.title: Yield to a municipal bus signalling to re-enter traffic
rules.when: approaching in the lane adjacent to a BUS BAY AND the municipal bus in the bay flashes its left-turn signal to re-enter traffic
rules.action: yield and allow the bus to re-enter the traffic lane
rules.statement: WHEN approaching in the lane adjacent to a BUS BAY AND the municipal bus in the bay flashes its left-turn signal to re-enter traffic, the DRIVER MUST yield and allow the bus to re-enter the traffic lane.
rules.note: The rear-of-bus yield sign reminds drivers of the rule at a dedicated bus stop.

rules.title: Prepare to stop for a school bus flashing amber
rules.when: approaching a SCHOOL BUS from the rear or front AND its overhead amber lights are flashing
rules.action: slow down and prepare to stop
rules.unless: approaching from the front on the opposite side of a MEDIAN
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a SCHOOL BUS from the rear or front AND its overhead amber lights are flashing, the DRIVER MUST slow down and prepare to stop, UNLESS approaching from the front on the opposite side of a MEDIAN.
rules.note: Amber signals that the bus is coming to a stop to pick up or drop off passengers; it is distinct from the red-light or stop-arm stopping requirement.

rules.title: Stop at least 20 metres behind a school bus displaying red lights or its stop arm
rules.when: approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from behind with its overhead red lights flashing OR approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from behind with its stop arm activated
rules.action: stop at least 20 metres behind the bus
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from behind with its overhead red lights flashing OR approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from behind with its stop arm activated, the DRIVER MUST stop at least 20 metres behind the bus.
rules.penalty: Heavy fine and six demerit points for a first failure to stop; the fine may also apply to the registered owner.
rules.note: This applies on either an undivided road or the bus's side of a divided road, regardless of the number of lanes, speed limit or school hours.

rules.title: Stop when meeting a school bus displaying red lights or its stop arm
rules.when: approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from the front with its overhead red lights flashing OR approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from the front with its stop arm activated
rules.action: stop at a safe distance for children to get off the bus and cross in front of the vehicle
rules.unless: the SCHOOL BUS is on the opposite side of a MEDIAN
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from the front with its overhead red lights flashing OR approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS from the front with its stop arm activated, the DRIVER MUST stop at a safe distance for children to get off the bus and cross in front of the vehicle, UNLESS the SCHOOL BUS is on the opposite side of a MEDIAN.
rules.penalty: Heavy fine and six demerit points for a first failure to stop; the fine may also apply to the registered owner.

vague_terms.explanation: no numerical distance is specified for a front approach

rules.note: The handbook's 20-metre requirement is for the rear approach, not the front approach; on undivided multi-lane highways drivers in both directions must stop.

rules.title: Remain stopped until the school bus has finished signalling and moved
rules.when: stopped for a SCHOOL BUS displaying overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: proceed
rules.unless: the bus has moved AND its overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND its stop arm is no longer activated
rules.statement: WHEN stopped for a SCHOOL BUS displaying overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST NOT proceed, UNLESS the bus has moved AND its overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND its stop arm is no longer activated.
rules.note: The sharing-the-road passage expressly lists all three conditions. The stopping chapter says the bus moves or the lights stop, then separately directs drivers to remain stopped until the arm folds away and the lights stop flashing. This entry uses the stronger wording.

rules.title: Pass a streetcar passenger island or zone cautiously
rules.when: passing a streetcar stop with an area set aside for boarding and alighting passengers
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for sudden or unexpected pedestrian movements
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar stop with an area set aside for boarding and alighting passengers, the DRIVER MUST pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for sudden or unexpected pedestrian movements.

vague_terms.explanation: no numerical passing speed is specified

rules.note: The two-metre stopping rule does not apply at these stops.

rules.title: Pass streetcars on the right
rules.when: passing a streetcar
rules.action: pass it on the right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar, the DRIVER MUST pass it on the right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.
rules.note: The exception removes the requirement to pass on the right on a one-way road; it does not remove any stopping requirement at a streetcar stop.

rules.title: Stop two metres behind the rear doors at a streetcar stop
rules.when: approaching from behind a stopped streetcar while passengers are getting on or off
rules.action: stop and stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors
rules.unless: an area is set aside for streetcar passengers at that stop
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from behind a stopped streetcar while passengers are getting on or off, the DRIVER MUST stop and stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors, UNLESS an area is set aside for streetcar passengers at that stop.
rules.note: The figure shows a vehicle stopped behind the rear doors, not two metres behind the rear bumper.

rules.title: Do not speed up while another driver is passing
rules.when: another driver is trying to pass the driver's vehicle
rules.action: speed up to impede the pass or otherwise drive to prevent the other vehicle from passing
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to pass the driver's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up to impede the pass or otherwise drive to prevent the other vehicle from passing.
rules.note: The passing chapter calls speeding up while another driver is trying to pass unlawful without requiring proof of intent; the sanctions chapter also identifies driving to prevent a pass as aggressive driving.

rules.title: Move right and let faster traffic pass
rules.when: a faster vehicle is about to overtake the driver's vehicle
rules.action: move to the right and allow the vehicle to pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN a faster vehicle is about to overtake the driver's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and allow the vehicle to pass in safety.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum clearance is specified

rules.note: The passing chapter gives a direct command; the answered knowledge-test question states the action as a must.

rules.title: Help a passing driver return on an undivided road
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road AND the passing driver has moved into the oncoming lane
rules.action: watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right edge of the lane, and be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver return sooner if needed to prevent a collision
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road AND the passing driver has moved into the oncoming lane, the DRIVER MUST watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right edge of the lane, and be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver return sooner if needed to prevent a collision.

vague_terms.explanation: no offset is specified

vague_terms.term: if needed to prevent a collision
vague_terms.explanation: the driver must judge the closing gap and collision risk

rules.title: Check for passing traffic before opening a parked vehicle door
rules.when: parked beside the roadway and about to open a vehicle door next to traffic
rules.action: open the door
rules.unless: the DRIVER has looked behind and checked mirrors and blind spots for passing cyclists and other traffic AND opening the door will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic
rules.statement: WHEN parked beside the roadway and about to open a vehicle door next to traffic, the DRIVER MUST NOT open the door, UNLESS the DRIVER has looked behind and checked mirrors and blind spots for passing cyclists and other traffic AND opening the door will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for improper opening of a vehicle door.

vague_terms.term: will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum clearance or time gap is specified

rules.note: The diagram shows the danger of opening a door into a passing cyclist's path.

rules.title: Use the Dutch reach to check for passing traffic
rules.when: opening the driver's door of a parked vehicle next to traffic
rules.action: use the right hand to open the door so that the movement prompts a shoulder check
rules.statement: WHEN opening the driver's door of a parked vehicle next to traffic, the DRIVER SHOULD use the right hand to open the door so that the movement prompts a shoulder check.
rules.note: The handbook calls this the Dutch reach and presents it as good practice.

rules.title: Limit how long a parked vehicle door stays open next to traffic
rules.when: a parked vehicle door must be opened next to traffic to load or unload passengers
rules.action: keep the door open only long enough to load or unload the passengers
rules.statement: WHEN a parked vehicle door must be opened next to traffic to load or unload passengers, the DRIVER MUST keep the door open only long enough to load or unload the passengers.

vague_terms.explanation: no duration is specified beyond the time needed for passengers

rules.title: Check the blind spot if another vehicle may overtake during a turn
rules.actor: DRIVER taking the Level Two road test
rules.when: preparing to turn at an intersection AND another vehicle could overtake during the turn
rules.action: check the blind spot before starting the turn
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn at an intersection AND another vehicle could overtake during the turn, the DRIVER taking the Level Two road test MUST check the blind spot before starting the turn.

vague_terms.explanation: the driver must judge whether another vehicle could get alongside

rules.note: This specific trigger appears in the road-test guide; the general turning guidance also calls for checking blind spots.

rules.title: Check for traffic overtaking on the right before pulling over
rules.actor: DRIVER taking the Level Two road test
rules.when: preparing to pull over for a roadside stop AND traffic or pedestrians could overtake on the right
rules.action: check the right blind spot just before pulling over
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pull over for a roadside stop AND traffic or pedestrians could overtake on the right, the DRIVER taking the Level Two road test MUST check the right blind spot just before pulling over.

vague_terms.explanation: the driver must judge whether there is a possible path on the right
no exact timing is specified

rules.note: The general roadside-stop instructions call for a mirror and blind-spot check before slowing; the road-test passage adds this last check.

rules.title: Allow for slower acceleration and greater length when towing
rules.when: considering passing another vehicle
rules.action: check before passing that there is enough time and room to complete the pass given the combination's slower acceleration and greater length
rules.statement: WHEN considering passing another vehicle, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST check before passing that there is enough time and room to complete the pass given the combination's slower acceleration and greater length.

vague_terms.explanation: no trailer-specific gap or time is specified

rules.title: Leave more room before returning with a trailer
rules.when: returning to the original lane after passing another vehicle
rules.action: allow more room before moving back and avoid cutting back too soon
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after passing another vehicle, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST allow more room before moving back and avoid cutting back too soon.

vague_terms.explanation: no additional clearance is given
no minimum time is specified

rules.note: Cutting back too soon can cause trailer sway.

rules.title: Pull over to let queued traffic pass
rules.when: holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over, and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST signal, pull over, and let the other vehicles pass.

vague_terms.term: holding up a line of traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no queue length or delay threshold is specified

rules.title: Steer rather than brake if a passing truck or bus pushes the trailer sideways
rules.when: air turbulence from a passing large truck or bus pushes the trailer sideways
rules.action: steer the vehicle and trailer carefully back into position without braking
rules.statement: WHEN air turbulence from a passing large truck or bus pushes the trailer sideways, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST steer the vehicle and trailer carefully back into position without braking.

vague_terms.explanation: no steering rate is specified

rules.note: The handbook says a slight increase in speed may help with the disturbance behind the passing vehicle; that is not permission to accelerate to impede a pass.
